question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

It is time for the factory __to being closed__.
solution:
The correct answer is **'to be closed'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'to be closed'** should be used instead of** 'to being closed'.**
 
• We know that after '**to**' **infinitive** the **base** form of the **verb (here, 'be')** is used.
 
 
• *Example: So many things in life seem **to be a test **of some kind.*
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *It is time for the factory **to be closed.***** **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है।
 
• यहां **'to being closed'** के बजाय **'to be closed' **का प्रयोग किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• हम जानते हैं कि **'to' infinitive** के बाद **verb** के **base form** (यहाँ, 'be') का प्रयोग होता है।
 
 
• ​*Example: So many things in life seem to be a test of some kind.*
 
 
 
• अत: सही उत्तर **विकल्प 4 **है।
